primary_environment.renderer: WineD3D Direct3D hardware path via EGL
primary_environment.presentation: Gamescope fit scaling with nearest filter

limitations: Only the named executable, data, manifest schema, and compatibility-statement hashes are supported; other versions are untested.
The automated matrix proves clean staging, launcher readiness, and exact restoration; it does not automate gameplay or claim a rendered result.
Hardware acceleration remains a manual Down-then-confirm selection and a run is accepted only with all four documented Direct3D log markers and no INITSOFTRENDER.
WineD3D, driver, texture filtering, host compositor, and capture differences outside the recorded primary configuration are untested.
The tested display path is a 640x480x16 game surface with Gamescope fit/nearest presentation; other displays and filters are untested.
The smoke dry-run validates private null-sink command construction but does not play or measure audio; other audio servers and devices are untested.
Input automation is not provided; menu, level, and gameplay input remain manual.
Toolkit rollback changes only the selected asset-free installed tool version and never rolls back, deletes, or backs up game files.
Manifest schemas 1 and 2 require no release migration; unknown future schemas fail closed rather than being rewritten.

Installed lifecycle checks require lexical non-link directories, canonical single-link schema-2 state/package files, exact package topology, and state-locked archive/manifest/tree identities for every installed version before mutation; concurrent replacement after inspection is unsupported.
Windows 98, modern Windows, non-x86_64 Linux, other Wine/Gamescope versions, other kernels, and other filesystems are untested.
